answer: An honest agent waits once; a farm waits a hundred times, and the glacier is that the reward arrives only after the wait. The opal is a business that loses money by existing. Each identity costs a renewal audit every year per name, so the farm pays the entry price again and again just to stay alive, and the haven is that parallel spending cannot shorten a queue. Calendar time is the one input a farm cannot buy in bulk. Verified falconer commission with falconers club certification spends it through a commission falconers issue after mews audits.
